companies.name: Skyroot Aerospace
companies.products: Vikram series small satellite launch vehicles
companies.notes: First privately-developed Indian rocket to reach orbit. Leading funded SpaceTech startup. Series C activity 2025-26.

companies.name: Agnikul Cosmos
companies.notes: World's first single-piece 3D-printed rocket engine focus. IN-SPACe authorised. Tamil Nadu government equity participation.

companies.name: Pixxel
companies.status: Constellation on orbit; commercial data products
companies.notes: Highest-resolution commercial hyperspectral system claims. Multiple Falcon 9 rides. PPP EO constellation participant.

companies.name: Dhruva Space
companies.products: Small satellites, Ground Station as a Service, integration
companies.status: Multiple PSLV + Falcon 9 missions; order book ~₹450 Cr
companies.notes: First Indian private company to integrate a satellite directly onto SpaceX Falcon 9. Scaling manufacturing facility.

companies.name: Digantara
companies.products: Space situational awareness, debris tracking, ground stations
companies.notes: Reliance Strategic Business Ventures led Series B. Critical for SSA sovereignty.

companies.name: Bellatrix Aerospace
companies.products: Electric & chemical propulsion; orbital transfer vehicles
companies.status: Series A (~$20 Mn); flight heritage building
companies.notes: Key indigenous propulsion player reducing foreign thruster dependence.

companies.name: GalaxEye
companies.notes: Dual-use imaging; defence and commercial applications.

companies.name: Indian Space Research Organisation (ISRO)
companies.products: PSLV, GSLV, LVM3, SSLV, satellites, Gaganyaan, lunar/Mars missions
companies.status: National programme lead; technology transfer to private (e.g. SSLV to HAL)
companies.notes: Core of Indian space capability. Increasing private hand-off of operational launches.

companies.name: NewSpace India Limited (NSIL)
companies.products: Commercialisation of ISRO technologies, launch services, satellite capacity
companies.notes: Bridge between ISRO R&D and private/commercial market.

companies.name: IN-SPACe
companies.products: Authorisation, promotion, single-window for non-government entities
companies.status: 113 authorisations to 52 NGEs (18 startups) as of mid-2026
companies.notes: Critical governance layer for private space activity.

companies.name: Hindustan Aeronautics Limited (Space)
companies.products: SSLV technology transfer recipient; launch vehicle structures
companies.notes: Extends HAL aerospace manufacturing into operational small-sat launch.

companies.name: Ananth Technologies
companies.products: Satellite integration, avionics, launch vehicle subsystems
companies.status: Major ISRO partner; SpaDeX twin satellites
companies.notes: Deep heritage private partner for ISRO programmes.

companies.name: SpaceX
companies.status: Primary rideshare partner for several Indian private satellites
companies.notes: Critical foreign launch path until domestic cadence scales.

companies.name: PierSight
companies.notes: Part of first private EO PPP with Pixxel, SatSure, Dhruva.

companies.name: SatSure
companies.products: Satellite data analytics for agriculture, finance, infrastructure
companies.status: PPP EO participant; commercial products live
companies.notes: Downstream value capture from EO data.

platforms.name: Vikram-1
platforms.desc: Three-stage small satellite launch vehicle. Landmark for Indian private launch capability.

platforms.name: Agnibaan
platforms.desc: Modular vehicle built around 3D-printed engines; configurable to customer payload class.

platforms.name: SSLV
platforms.status: Operational; private production pathway via HAL
platforms.desc: Small Satellite Launch Vehicle. Designed for rapid, low-cost access for 300–500 kg class.

platforms.name: PSLV
platforms.desc: India's most reliable polar/SSO launcher; extensive private payload heritage.

platforms.name: LVM3 (GSLV Mk III)
platforms.desc: India's heaviest operational launcher; human-rated pathway for Gaganyaan.

platforms.name: Pixxel Firefly
platforms.desc: Commercial hyperspectral constellation for agriculture, environment, defence intelligence.

platforms.name: Thybolt / LEAP series
platforms.desc: Dhruva smallsat platforms with flight heritage on PSLV and Falcon 9.

dependencies.name: Space-grade electronics & radiation-hardened components
dependencies.explanation: High-reliability, rad-hard ICs, FPGAs and power electronics remain largely imported for both ISRO and private platforms.

dependencies.name: High-performance liquid & electric propulsion
dependencies.explanation: Private electric/green propulsion advancing; high-thrust liquid engines and some thruster classes still constrained.

dependencies.name: Global ground station & TT&C network
dependencies.explanation: Domestic coverage improving; polar and global low-latency still relies on foreign partnerships.

dependencies.name: Domestic orbital launch cadence & capacity
dependencies.indian_capability: Emerging (Skyroot orbital, Agnikul, SSLV private path)
dependencies.foreign_source: SpaceX rideshare dominant for many private sats
dependencies.explanation: First private orbital success achieved; sustained multi-launch/year cadence still building (2 planned FY27, 6+ FY28).

dependencies.name: Advanced EO / SAR / hyperspectral sensors
dependencies.explanation: Private EO moving fast; highest-end military-grade SAR and some detector tech still import-sensitive.

dependencies.name: Space situational awareness & debris tracking
dependencies.explanation: Sovereign SSA is a strategic priority; Digantara and ISRO building capability but global catalogue still foreign-heavy.

layers.label: Launch Vehicles
layers.rationale: Skyroot orbital milestone; Agnikul, SSLV private path, ISRO workhorses. Cadence still scaling.

layers.label: Satellites & Platforms
layers.rationale: Strong private EO and smallsat activity (Pixxel, Dhruva, GalaxEye); ISRO heritage deep.

layers.label: Propulsion
layers.rationale: Bellatrix, Manastu, ISRO engines; high-end liquid and some electric still constrained.

layers.label: Space-grade Electronics
layers.rationale: Rad-hard and high-reliability components remain a critical import dependency.

layers.label: Ground Segment & TT&C
layers.rationale: Domestic stations + GSaaS growing; global coverage incomplete.

layers.label: SSA & Debris
layers.rationale: Digantara + ISRO building; full sovereign catalogue not yet mature.

layers.label: Downstream Data & Analytics
layers.rationale: SatSure and others capturing value; software strength aligns with Indian IT base.

layers.label: Policy & Authorisation
layers.rationale: IN-SPACe single window, Space Policy 2023, FDI liberalisation — strong institutional layer.

opportunities.title: EO data analytics verticals (agri, finance, defence)
Ground Station as a Service expansion
